blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Object detection models rely on large-scale annotated datasets that require substantial manual annotation effort. The labeling costs further increase when annotation uncertainty is captured through soft labels, as multiple annotations must be collected for each object. We address this challenge by introducing a semi-supervised framework for the uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets. Our approach leverages open-vocabulary object detectors to generate region proposals and semantically meaningful object representations. Based on these representations, we construct an object-level similarity graph and propagate probabilistic label information. Our framework assigns soft labels to previously unlabeled objects, quantifying both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. We evaluate our method on four object detection benchmarks with soft-label annotations and demonstrate that high-quality annotations can be obtained with only a small fraction of manually labeled objects. Furthermore, we show that detectors trained on semi-automatically annotated data achieve performance comparable to models trained on fully manually annotated data. We achieve state-of-the-art downstream detection performance for the task of semi-supervised object detection on the COCO dataset, with 40.5% AP virtually matching the performance of the model trained on fully manually constructed data (40.9%) at only 1% of labeling costs. These results highlight the potential of open-vocabulary models and graph-based label propagation for efficient, accurate and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling.
blocks.zh: 对象检测模型依赖于需要大量人工注释的大规模注释数据集. 标签成本在通过软标签获取注释不确定性时会进一步增加,因为每个对象必须收集多条注释. 我们通过引入一个半监督框架来应对这一挑战,即对物体检测数据集的不确定性作出认知。 我们的方法利用了开放式的活性物体探测器,生成区域建议和具有高度意义的物体表示。 基于这些表述,我们构建出一个对象级相似性图并传播概率标签信息. 我们的框架为以前没有标签的物体分配了软标签,量化了厌食和感知的不确定性。 我们用四个带有软标签说明的物体探测基准来评价我们的方法,并表明只有一小部分手动标记物体才能获得高质量的说明. 此外,我们显示,经过半自动附加说明数据培训的探测器的性能与经过完全人工附加说明数据培训的模型相当。 在COCO数据集上实现半监控对象检测任务最先进的下游检测性能,40.5%的AP几乎匹配了完全人工构建的数据所训练的模型性能(40.9%),其标签成本仅为1%. 这些结果突出表明了公开票价模型和以图表为基础的标签传播对有效、准确和不确定的假标签的潜在作用。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Modern object detectors rely on large-scale annotated datasets, whose creation requires substantial manual effort.
In contrast to image classification, object detection annotations must specify the location and category of every object, making dataset construction particularly time-consuming.
Furthermore, existing object detection benchmarks generally treat annotations as deterministic, despite the fact that ambiguity is inherent to many detection tasks due to occlusions, unclear object boundaries, blurring, and semantic uncertainty.
Recently, object detection datasets that capture semantic uncertainty were proposed [ 1 , 2 ] . Annotation uncertainty is captured through multiple independent annotations, often more than ten human evaluations per object. While such approaches provide valuable information about human uncertainty, their annotation costs may limit scalability.
This motivates the development of semi-automated methods that can efficiently propagate label information and capture semantic uncertainty.
While graph-based semi-supervised techniques proved to be effective in image classification [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] , similar methods for uncertainty-aware annotation in object detection remain unexplored.
blocks.zh:
现代物体探测器依赖于大规模注解数据集,其创建需要大量的人工努力.
相对于图像分类,对象检测说明必须指定每个对象的位置和类别,使得数据集构造特别费时.
此外,现有的物体探测基准一般将说明视为决定性的,尽管许多探测任务由于被包围、物体界限不清、模糊不清和语义不确定而固有的模糊性。
最近,提出了能够捕捉语义不确定性的物体检测数据集[1,2]. 通过多个独立说明记录了注释的不确定性,每个对象往往有十多个人类评价. 虽然这些办法提供了关于人类不确定性的宝贵信息,但其注释成本可能会限制可扩展性。
这推动了半自动方法的发展,能够有效地传播标签信息并捕捉语义不确定性.
虽然基于图的半监督技术在图像分类[3,4,5]中被证明是有效的,但在物体检测中类似方法的不确定性-意识注释仍然没有得到探讨.

blocks.en:
In this work, we develop graph-based semi-supervised learning in the domain of object detection by leveraging powerful open-vocabulary object detectors such as Grounding DINO [ 6 ] to generate initial region proposals and semantically meaningful object representations.
With these object representations, we construct a similarity graph over which label information is propagated ( Figure 1 ). To propagate label information, we rely on probabilistic label spreading [ 5 ] which generalizes classical label spreading [ 3 ] to the domain of soft labels and accounts for aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty.
This way, our method propagates (potentially noisy) label information obtained for few objects to other localized but yet unlabeled objects. This enables the uncertainty-aware, semi-automated annotation of object detection datasets. As a result, all detected objects are equipped with a soft label that reflects the individual class probabilities, including the background class.
Soft labels generalize conventional labels and reflect the aleatoric uncertainty associated with label assignments [ 7 ] . They allow for uncertainty-aware training [ 8 ] and thorough assessment of model uncertainty [ 2 ] .
Creating soft labels manually requires the repeated evaluation of instances by multiple annotators so that datasets with soft labels are rare [ 5 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们通过利用强大的开放-vocabulary物体探测器,如Grounding DINO[6],在物体探测领域发展基于图表的半监督学习,生成初步的区域建议和精密有意义的物体表示.
借助这些对象表示,我们构建了一个类似图,以宣传标签信息(图1)。 为了传播标签信息,我们依靠概率标签传播[5] 将古典标签概括到软标签领域,并记录了厌食和感知不确定性。
这样,我们的方法就向其他局部但无标签的物体传播(可能吵闹的)为少数物体获得的标签信息。 这使得能够对物体检测数据集进行有不确定性的半自动注释。 因此,所有被检测到的物体都配备了反映单个类概率的软标签,包括背景类.
软标签概括常规标签,并反映与标签任务相关的疲软不确定性[7]. 它们允许进行了解不确定性的培训[8]和彻底评估模式不确定性[2]。
手动创建软标签需要多个注释器对实例进行反复评价,这样带有软标签的数据集就很少[5,2].

blocks.en:
In the domain of object detection, [ 2 ] re-annotated the four object detection benchmarks COCO [ 9 ] , Pascal VOC [ 10 ] , KITTI [ 11 ] and Cityscapes [ 12 ] where they equipped objects with soft labels based on at least 11 human annotations. We evaluate our framework on these datasets and quantify achieved data quality in terms of average precision [ 9 ] and its soft label variant average similarity [ 2 ] .
The results demonstrate that high-quality uncertainty-aware annotations can be obtained from only a small fraction of manually labeled objects, substantially reducing annotation effort while maintaining competitive data quality.
We can further reduce annotation effort by integrating active querying to steer the selection of objects to annotate next. We also show that our framework can effectively uncover label errors in existing datasets.
Notably, we observe that the quality of semi-automatically constructed data is sufficiently high for downstream tasks such as training closed-set object detectors. Consequently, our framework achieves state-of-the art downstream detection performance in semi-supervised object detection [ 13 , 14 ] on the COCO dataset, with 40.5% AP essentially matching the fully supervised performance of 40.9% at only 1% of labeling costs. We summarize our main contributions as follows: • We introduce the first graph-based semi-supervised framework for uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets.
It leverages open-vocabulary models and probabilistic label spreading to estimate soft labels of objects, capturing both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on four standard datasets. We obtain accurate annotations at a fraction of annotation effort where our method consistently outperforms baselines in terms of label quality. • We integrate active querying to further reduce the annotation effort required to obtain accurate annotations. • We show that training on semi-automatically constructed annotations yields comparable performance, compared to training on original annotations, setting a new state of the art in semi-supervised object detection on COCO.
blocks.zh:

结果显示,只有一小部分手动标注的物体可以获得高质量的不确定性-意识说明,大大减少了注解努力,同时保持了竞争性数据质量.
我们可以通过整合主动查询来进一步减少注释努力,引导对象选择来进行下一个注释. 我们还表明,我们的框架能够有效地发现现有数据集中的标签错误。
值得注意的是,我们观察到,半自动构造数据的质量足够高,可以用于下游任务,例如训练闭合装置物体探测器。 因此,我们的框架在COCO数据集上实现了半监督物体检测[13,14]中最先进的下游检测性能,40.5%的AP基本上匹配了40.9%的全监督性能,只有1%的标签成本. 我们的主要贡献总结如下: 我们引入了第一个基于图表的半监督框架,用于对物体检测数据集的不确定性-认知注释.

It leverages open-vocabulary models and probabilistic label spreading to estimate soft labels of objects, capturing both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Method overview: Initial region proposals form a graph based on feature similarity and individual objects are queried for manual inspection. The queried object is assigned either one of the dataset’s classes or the background class. This label information is then propagated over the similarity graph resulting in soft label estimates for each object proposal. The estimate is iteratively refined with each object that is inspected.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Semi-supervised learning (SSL) on graphs is an established research field with seminal contributions by [ 15 , 3 ] .
Early work on label propagation [ 15 ] combines labeled and unlabeled data in a graph whose edge weights are typically derived from a Gaussian kernel. Class information from labeled samples is then iteratively propagated to neighboring unlabeled nodes while preserving the original seed labels.
Building on this idea, label spreading [ 3 ] relaxes the hard clamping of initial labels and performs a diffusion process over the graph, where a parameter α \alpha governs the balance between propagated and initial label information.
Since their introduction, numerous extensions have been proposed, including formulations based on hypergraphs [ 16 , 17 ] , methods designed for improved scalability and computational efficiency [ 18 , 19 ] , and alternative strategies for graph construction.
Comprehensive surveys of graph-based semi-supervised learning can be found in [ 20 , 4 ] .
Beyond label propagation methods, annotation-efficient learning paradigms such as active learning and human-in-the-loop systems have been introduced to further reduce labeling costs in semi-automated annotation frameworks [ 21 , 22 ] .
While label propagation is well-studied in the domain of image classification, no approaches for object detection datasets exist. We propose the transfer of established graph-based SSL techniques to the domain of object detection by leveraging open-vocabulary models for initial region proposals and semantic object representations.
blocks.zh:
在图上的半监督学习(SSL)是一个既定的研究领域,在[15,3]前有开创性贡献.
标签传播的早期工作[15]将标签数据与无标签数据合并在一个图中,其边缘重量一般来自高斯内核. 标有标签的样品的分类信息随后在保留原始种子标签的同时,反复传播到邻近的无标签节点.
基于这个想法,标签传播[3]放松了对初始标签的硬夹,并在图表上进行扩散过程,其中一个参数α\α规范了已传播和初始标签信息之间的平衡.
自采用以来,已提出了许多扩展建议,包括基于[16、17]的配方、为提高可伸缩性和计算效率而设计的方法[18、19],以及图表构造的替代战略。
对以图表为基础的半监督学习的全面调查可见于[20,4].
除了标签传播方法外,还采用了注解效率高的学习范式,如主动学习和人行录系统,以进一步降低半自动注解框架中的标签费用[21、22]。
虽然在图像分类领域对标签的传播进行了深入的研究,但是没有关于物体检测数据集的方法。 我们提议通过利用开放-vocabulary模型,将既有的基于图表的SSL技术转移到对象检测领域,用于初始区域提案和语义对象表示.

blocks.en:
Semi-automated annotation of objects is well-established for video data where objects are annotated based on only a few labeled frames [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] .
Here, annotated objects are to be re-identified in other frames of the video to propagate initial label information. This is typically achieved by appropriate feature extraction and leveraging motion cues for temporal consistency.
The task is different from semi-automated annotation of object detection datasets since the data consists of similar scenes and labels are typically only propagated to the same objects across frames.
blocks.zh:
半自动地对物体进行注解,用于视频数据,仅根据几个标记框对物体进行注解[23、24、25、26、27]。
在此,注释对象将在视频的其他帧中重新识别,以传播初始标签信息. 这通常通过适当的特性提取和利用运动提示实现时间一致性。
这项任务不同于对物体检测数据集的半自动注释,因为数据由相似的场景组成,标签通常只跨帧传播给同一个物体.

blocks.en:
Wang et al. [ 28 ] conduct label propagation on an instance level. They construct a similarity graph over embeddings of segmented objects to propagate labels across instances using label spreading [ 3 ] . For this, the existence of segments is assumed even for unlabeled images.
The method is designed for multi instance, single label datasets where an image is associated with multiple objects but only a single label. This work derives image labels through label propagation on the instance level.
In contrast, our method introduces label propagation for object detection datasets and leverages open-vocabulary models for region proposals.
blocks.zh:
王等编. [28] 在实例一级进行标签传播。 它们构建一个类似图,在分块物体的嵌入之上,使用分布的标签在各种实例中传播标签[3]。 为此,即使对于无标签的图像,也假定存在片段.
该方法用于多个实例,单一标签数据集,其中一个图像与多个对象相关联,但只有一个标签. 本文通过实例层面的标签传播获得图像标签。
与此相对照,我们的方法引入了用于物体检测数据集的标签传播,并带动了用于区域提案的开放式投票模型。

blocks.en:
Tutevych et al. [ 29 ] propose a framework for the semi-automated annotation of instance segmentation datasets.
A pretrained model is used for region proposals and proposed segments are embedded with multiple foundation models. The separation of classes in the embedding space is then learned using a contrastive loss.
While this framework contains conceptually related ideas, it relies on a segmentation model pretrained on similar data and requires training for accurate label propagation. Instead, we focus on object detection datasets and do not require any training data besides the few labeled examples provided for label propagation.
blocks.zh:
Tutevych等人[29]提出了实例分块数据集半自动注释框架。
区域提案使用预先训练好的模型,提议的部分包含多个基础模型。 嵌入空间中的类的分离,然后用对比损失来学习.
虽然这一框架包含概念上相关的想法,但它依赖于预先经过类似数据培训的分块模型,需要培训准确的标签传播。 相反,我们把重点放在物体检测数据集上,不需要任何培训数据,除了为标签传播提供的少数标签实例外。

blocks.en:
While there is no prior work that applies graph-based SSL techniques in the domain of object detection, the research field of semi-supervised object detection is related to our approach.
Methods in this field seek to improve detection performance by leveraging additional unlabeled data during training [ 30 , 31 , 13 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 14 ] .
Typically, learning-based approaches are proposed that generate pseudo-labels based on few initial labels.
These pseudo-labels can then be used as additional supervision during detector training which was shown to improve performance, compared to training with the limited labeled data available.
Most existing approaches formulate semi-supervision at the image level and use detector-generated pseudo-labels rather than modeling similarities between object instances across the dataset.
In addition, approaches like CSD [ 31 ] , STAC [ 13 ] , Humble Teacher [ 33 ] , Consistent Teacher [ 36 ] are learning-based, typically involving a student-teacher structure and data augmentations, which implies training overhead and high computational costs.
We develop graph-based SSL in the domain of object detection by leveraging open-vocabulary models which does not require training and offers explainability through appropriate quantification of both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty of pseudo-labels.
blocks.zh:
虽然在物体探测领域没有应用基于图表的SSL技术的先前工作,但半监督物体探测的研究领域与我们的方法有关.
这一领域的方法力求通过利用培训期间的其他无标签数据来改进检测工作[30、31、13、32、33、34、35、36、14]。
通常情况下,建议采用基于学习的方法,以很少的初始标签为基础产生伪标签。
然后,在探测器培训期间,这些伪标签可以用作额外的监督,这与现有的有限标签数据相比,证明可以提高性能。
大多数现有方法在图像层面形成半监督,并使用探测器生成的伪标签,而不是在整个数据集中模拟物体实例之间的相似性.
此外,诸如CSD[31],STAC[13],Humble Teacher[33],一致 教师[36]以学习为基础,通常涉及学生-教师结构和数据增强,这意味着培训间接费用和高计算费用。
在物体探测领域,我们开发基于图表的SSL,利用不需要培训的开放式甚高频模型,并通过适当量化假标签的振动和感知不确定性,提供可解释性。

blocks.en:
Recent advances in open-vocabulary object detection enable localization of arbitrary object categories through text prompts [ 37 , 6 , 38 ] .
Models such as Grounding DINO [ 6 ] have demonstrated strong zero shot performance and are increasingly used as building blocks for data annotation [ 39 , 40 ] .
In this work, we leverage open-vocabulary detectors to generate region proposals and object representations based on which we conduct graph-based label propagation. We compare our framework to the performance of these models alone.
blocks.zh:
近期开放-vocabulary对象检测的进展使得通过文本提示[37,6,38]可以将任意对象类别本地化.
Grounding DINO [6] 等模型已经显示出强烈的零射线性能,并越来越多地被用作数据注释的构件[39,40].
在这项工作中,我们利用公开的省道探测器,生成区域提案和物体说明,在此基础上,我们进行基于图表的标签传播。 我们仅将我们的框架与这些模式的绩效进行比较。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en:
We introduce a graph-based semi-supervised framework for the uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets.
Given a small set of annotated objects, label information propagates to unlabeled object instances while both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty are captured.
To this end, we leverage open-vocabulary models to generate object proposals and semantically meaningful object representations.
A similarity graph is constructed over these representations and probabilistic label spreading (PLS) [ 5 ] is applied to diffuse information throughout the object-level graph.
An overview of our method is illustrated in Figure 2 where individual objects are iteratively queried for evaluation and received label information propagates. Importantly, our method also models background probabilities by including a distinct background class, which enables the separation of foreground objects.
The complete annotation framework consists of open-vocabulary model inference, post-hoc calibration of raw confidence and PLS to propagate available label information and quantify aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty of soft label estimates.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了基于图表的半监督框架,用于对物体检测数据集的不确定性-认知注释.
由于有一小组附加说明的对象,标签信息传播到未加标签的对象实例,同时捕捉到厌食和癫痫不确定性。
为此,我们利用开放的省道模型来生成对象建议和精致有意义的对象表示.
在这些表示方式上构建了一个相似性图,将分布(PLS)[5]的概率标签应用于整个对象级图的传播信息.
图2概述了我们的方法,其中反复询问个别对象进行评价,并传播标签信息。 重要的是,我们的方法也通过包括一个独特的背景类来模拟背景概率,从而能够分离前景物体。
完整的注解框架包括开放-vocabulary模型推论,原始置信度的后校准和PLS,以传播现有的标签信息,量化软标签估计的饱和和感知不确定性.

blocks.en:
The task at hand is the semi-automated annotation of object detection datasets with soft labels.
We assume that a set of given images I 1 , … , I n I_{1},\ldots,I_{n} contains a collection of objects ℬ 1 , … , ℬ n \mathcal{B}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{B}_{n} and each individual object b j ∈ ℬ i b_{j}\in\mathcal{B}_{i} is associated with a soft label p j ∈ Δ C + 1 p_{j}\in\Delta^{C+1} , where C C is the number of classes in the dataset and Δ C + 1 \Delta^{C+1} denotes the C + 1 C+1 -dimensional probability simplex.
The soft label is a categorical probability distribution over all classes including background, i.e., p j = ( p j 1 , … , p j C , p j b ​ g ) ⊤ p_{j}=(p_{j}^{1},\ldots,p_{j}^{C},p_{j}^{bg})^{\top} such that ∑ i p j i = 1 \sum_{i}p_{j}^{i}=1 .
It captures the aleatoric uncertainty associated with label assignment for this particular object, which is inherent to object detection datasets due to occlusions, blurring, small object size and ambiguous class affiliations [ 2 ] .
In this setting, the GT comprises all objects prevalent in the images and the associated soft labels are the underlying semantic distributions, i.e., we assume that manual class assignments for an object follow this distribution. In practice, annotated datasets do not cover all objects and, soft labels, if existing at all, are merely approximations to the underlying distributions based on finitely many annotations collected.

We first apply an open-vocabulary object detector such as Grounding DINO [ 6 ] to all images and obtain a set of object proposals d ^ 1 , … , d ^ M {\hat{d}_{1},\ldots,\hat{d}_{M}} .
Each proposal d ^ j \hat{d}_{j} consists of a bounding box b ^ j \hat{b}_{j} , an objectness score s ^ j ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \hat{s}_{j}\in[0,1] , and an embedding vector v ^ j ∈ ℝ d \hat{v}_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} which encodes a representation of the detected object.
Open-vocabulary models provide semantically rich representations that generalize across object categories and enable meaningful comparisons between object instances. We capture this information with the hidden representations of detected objects. Based on these embeddings, we construct a similarity graph for label propagation.

blocks.en:
Obtaining reliable pseudo-labels requires the accurate assessment of proposed objects. One signal we leverage is the detector confidence itself.
Since model confidences are often poorly calibrated [ 41 ] , we conduct post-hoc calibration.
Based on the provided annotations, we evaluate a subset of detections and calibrate model confidence using Isotonic Regression [ 42 , 43 ] .
For each evaluated detection, the target for model confidence is 1 if one of the object classes was correctly localized or zero otherwise.
We then apply the regression model to all predictions and obtain post-hoc calibrated confidences.
Ultimately, our framework blends the calibrated detector confidence in a Bayesian setting with independent score estimates obtained through label propagation. The set of pseudo-labels then results from choosing a suitable confidence threshold so that sufficiently many objects are annotated but the number of false positives is low.

Edges are established between neighboring objects in the embedding space using a k k -nearest-neighbor graph to ensure computational efficiency. The affinity matrix W ∈ ℝ M × M W\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times M} is built with a Gaussian kernel as in [ 3 ] , i.e., W i ​ j = exp ⁡ ( − 1 2 ​ σ 2 ​ ‖ v ^ i − v ^ j ‖ 2 ) , W_{ij}=\exp\left(-\frac{1}{2\sigma^{2}}\|\hat{v}_{i}-\hat{v}_{j}\|^{2}\right), (1) where σ \sigma denotes the kernel’s bandwidth parameter and a non-zero weight is only assigned to edges where at least one node is among the k k -NN of the other. Diagonal entries of W W are set to zero to avoid self-reinforcement.
The affinity matrix captures semantic similarity between object instances across the entire dataset rather than within individual images and enables effective label propagation.

blocks.en:
Open-vocabulary detectors may generate false positive proposals. To account for this, we explicitly model the background class. During propagation, background information is treated analogously to semantic class information and contributes to the final probability estimates. This way, evaluated false positives enable the separation of foreground and background proposals.
Ultimately, each object proposal is assigned a soft label estimate p ^ j = ( p ^ j , 1 , … , p ^ j , C , p ^ j , bg ) \hat{p}_{j}=(\hat{p}_{j,1},\ldots,\hat{p}_{j,C},\hat{p}_{j,\mathrm{bg}}) that separates foreground and background objects and captures class ambiguity while epistemic uncertainty can be derived from the number of virtual labels received.

blocks.en: Overall, our framework requires only a small number of manually annotated objects and does not involve any additional model training. Instead, it exploits the semantic structure induced by open-vocabulary object detectors to propagate single annotations across object detection datasets.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的框架仅需要少量人工附加说明的对象,不涉及任何额外的模式培训。 相反,它利用了开放-vocabulary物体探测器诱导的语义结构,在物体探测数据集中传播单条注释.

blocks.en: IV Numerical Results
blocks.zh: 四 数字结果

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for the efficient and uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets. We compare our method to baselines and similar algorithms and evaluate it on an established benchmark for semi-supervised object detection [ 13 , 14 ] . We explore the effect of core components through ablation studies. We further reduce annotation costs through active label querying and demonstrate that our framework also uncovers label errors in existing datasets effectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,我们的框架对物体探测数据集的有效和不肯定性的说明是有效的。 我们比较我们的方法与基线和类似的算法,并按照半监督物体探测的既定基准加以评价[13,14]. 我们通过消化研究来探索核心成分的作用. 我们通过主动的标签查询进一步降低注释成本,并表明我们的框架还有效发现了现有数据集中的标签错误。

blocks.en: • In IV-B , we compare our method to baselines in terms of achieved data quality under limited annotation budget. • To assess the effectiveness of our method, we compare it with state-of-the-art semi-supervised object detection methods on an established benchmark in IV-C . • Ablation studies in IV-D provide an assessment of core components of our framework, in particular regarding the OVOD model employed and the feature space considered. • We explore further reduction of annotation costs by leveraging active querying in IV-E . • As another application of our framework, we demonstrate its effectiveness regarding label error detection in IV-F .

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method
for uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets
on four datasets for which soft labels are available. In [ 2 ] , common datasets were re-annotated from scratch with a focus on high coverage to also capture ambiguous cases. Identified objects were verified by at least 11 annotators, resulting in a soft label that quantifies human uncertainty.
Annotations are available for COCO [ 9 ] (validation split), Pascal VOC 2012 [ 10 ] , KITTI [ 11 ] (training split), and Cityscapes [ 12 ] . If multiple splits are available, we consider them as a single dataset to be annotated at once.

We generate initial detections using Grounding DINO [ 6 ] in a zero-shot setting.
Following the official inference procedure, all categories are concatenated into a single text prompt, enabling simultaneous detection of all classes.
Inference results in 300 detections per image where we extract prediction confidence for each class. For YOLO-World [ 38 ] and OWL-ViT [ 37 ] (considered in an ablation study), we follow the respective inference guidelines.

遵循官方推论程序,所有类别都被压缩成一个单一的文本提示,从而能够同时检测所有类别.
推论得出每个图像的300个检测结果, 我们得出每个类的预测可信度。 对于YOLO-World[38]和OWL-ViT[37](在一项通融研究中加以考虑),我们遵循各自的推论准则。

blocks.en:
To apply Probabilistic Label Spreading (PLS) [ 5 ] , we set up a k k -NN graph in the feature space of the ultimate hidden layer of the model’s decoder.
For Grounding DINO, these features have a dimension of 256.
We include all predictions with a score of 0.2 or higher in the graph.
The bandwidth σ \sigma of the Gaussian kernel is set to the average k k -NN radius of object features, i.e., the average Euclidean distance of a feature v ^ j \hat{v}_{j} to its k k -th NN. To ensure efficient computation, as proposed by [ 44 ] , we rely on Faiss [ 46 ] for nearest neighbor search and use Algebraic Multigrid solvers with GPU acceleration [ 47 ] to solve the linear system involved.

blocks.en:
Our framework considers initial region proposals as the pool of unlabeled objects.
We evaluate a fraction of these predictions regarding their class affiliation and propagate the resulting label information.
An annotation budget of 1% signifies that accordingly many predictions are evaluated.
Predictions are sampled with replacement as we expect the label assignment to be probabilistic.
We simulate the manual evaluation of predictions through IoU matching with the existing ground truth (GT) using a threshold of 0.5 0.5 .
If a prediction does not match with any GT object, the background class is assigned. If a matching bounding box exists, we sample a class from the corresponding soft label which simulates a single annotation.

我们评估其中一小部分关于其阶级归属的预测,并传播由此产生的标签信息。
1%的注释预算表明,对许多预测进行了相应的评价。
预测以替换方式进行抽样,因为我们期望标签分配是概率性的。
我们使用0.5 0.5的阈值模拟通过IoU与现有地面真理相匹配的预测的人工评估。
如果预测与任何GT对象不匹配,则会指定背景类. 如果匹配的边框存在,我们从相应的软标签中抽取一个类,模拟一个单一的注释.

blocks.en:
We compare our method to the baseline that uses the prediction confidence directly to include detections as pseudo-labels. Here, we keep all detections with a confidence of 0.5 or higher after post-hoc calibration.
Usually, confidence scores are only returned for the predicted class. To obtain a full soft label prediction, we extract confidence scores for the remaining classes as well and model the background probability as the product of counter-probabilities of all classes, i.e., p ^ b ​ g = ∏ κ = 1 C ( 1 − p ^ κ ) \hat{p}_{bg}=\prod_{\kappa=1}^{C}(1-\hat{p}_{\kappa}) where p ^ κ \hat{p}_{\kappa} is the calibrated predicted probability for the κ \kappa -th class.

通常情况下,信心分数只返回到预测的类. 为了获得完整的软标签预测,我们提取其余类的置信分数,并将背景概率作为所有类的反概率的产物模型,即p ^ b g = κ = 1 C (1 – p ^ ) \hat{p}_{bg}=\prod_{\kappa=1}(1-\hat{p}_{\kappa}) 其中 p ^\ hat{ p}_{\Kappa} 是 ^ kappa - 第1 类的校准预测概率。

The dotted line marks the AS ceiling where all correctly localized detections perfectly align with the corresponding soft labels.

blocks.en: IV-B Semi-automated, Uncertainty-aware Annotation of Object Detection Datasets
blocks.zh: 四-B 对物体探测数据集的半自动、不确定意识说明

blocks.en: We compare our method with similar techniques and baselines. All methods equip the initial region proposals with soft label estimates based on the evaluation of sampled objects. We assess the quality of the semi-automatically annotated dataset in terms of Average Similarity (AS) [ 2 ] , a metric that generalizes Average Precision (AP) to the domain of soft labels by replacing the binary notion of precision with a normalized similarity measure to compare predicted probability distributions with soft labels. We use 1 - total variation distance as similarity measure as proposed by [ 2 ] , while similarity is zero for false positive predictions. We also evaluate AP performance.
blocks.zh: 我们把方法与类似的技术和基线进行比较。 所有方法都为初步的区域提案配备了基于抽样对象评价的软标签估计. 我们以平均相似性(AS)[2]来评估半自动附加说明的数据集的质量,这一指标将平均精度(AP)概括到软标签领域,将精确度的二进制概念换成一个正常的相似性措施,将预测概率分布与软标签进行比较. 我们按[2]的建议将1 - 总变异距离作为相似度量,而对于假正预测,相似度为零. 我们也评估AP的表现.

blocks.en:
Comparable methods are Gaussian Kernel Regression (GKR) [ 48 , 49 ] which propagates label information using a Gaussian Kernel, and k k -NN regression where label information is averaged over the k k -NN out of the labeled instances.
For these parametrized methods, we conduct a grid search for hyperparameters and determine the best AS / AP value for each annotation budget for comparison. See appendix for more details and full parameter sweep results.
In addition, we consider two baselines.
First, we calibrate model confidence using isotonic regression and infer soft label estimates from calibrated probabilities as described above.
Second, we simulate fully manual annotation through hard-label injection. Here, we assign evaluated objects their labels but do not propagate information.
This yields a single annotation for evaluated objects and leaves non-evaluated objects at the soft label inferred from Grounding DINO scores.
blocks.zh:
可比较的方法有:高斯克内尔递归法(GKR)[48,49],使用高斯克内尔传播标签信息;和kk-NN回归法,标签信息在标注实例中的kk-NN上平均.
对于这些参数化方法,我们进行超参数的网格搜索,并确定每个注释预算的最佳AS/AP值进行比较。 详见附录和完整参数扫描结果。
此外,我们考虑两个基线。
首先,我们利用同位素回归来校准模型的置信度,并推断上述校准概率的软标签估计值。
其次,我们通过硬标签注射模拟全手动注释。 在这里,我们指定了评估对象的标签,但不传播信息。
这对被评价的物体产生单一的注释,并将未评价的物体放在从地面DINO分数推断的软标签上。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : Benchmark results for semi-supervised object detection [ 13 ] . Average precision of a Faster R-CNN model with ResNet-50 backbone is reported on COCO validation data. The model is trained on pseudo-labels which are constructed using the label information available for a fraction of images. At 100% budget, additional unlabeled COCO images are used.
blocks.zh: 图4:半监督物体检测基准结果[13]. 使用ResNet-50主干线的快速R-CNN模型的平均精确度报告于COCO验证数据。 模型使用假标签进行训练,这些标签是利用一小部分图像可用的标签信息构建的。 在100%的预算中,使用了额外的无标签COCO图像.

blocks.en:
As displayed in Figure 3 , on COCO validation data, our method achieves the highest AS at small annotation budgets (the regime of practical interest) and remains comparable to GKR as the budget grows further. Both clearly outperform calibrated Grounding DINO scores alone and hard-label injection across the full budget range, indicating that post-hoc calibration alone is insufficient to approximate soft label probabilities, and that manual hard-label annotation requires substantially more effort to derive high-quality soft labels.
At high budgets, semi-supervised methods approach the AS ceiling. This upper bound is mainly due to the detection capabilities of Grounding DINO which does not detect each GT object and produces false positives. To compute this ceiling, we assign matching predictions the GT soft labels where an IoU threshold of 0.5 is used to match objects.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,关于COCO验证数据,我们的方法在小注释预算(实际感兴趣的制度)中实现了最高AS,随着预算的进一步发展,它仍然与GKR相当。 单是明显优于定点DINO的分数和全预算范围的硬标签注射都表明,单是定点后就不足以估计软标签概率,人工硬标签注释需要付出更多的努力才能得出高质量的软标签。
在高预算,半监督方法接近AS上限. 这种上限主要由于地表DINO的探测能力,它不检测每个GT对象,产生假阳性. 为了计算这个天花板,我们指定匹配的GT软标签,其中使用0.5的IoU阈值来匹配对象.

blocks.en:
We evaluate achieved data quality in terms of AP in the appendix and find that our method surpasses Grounding DINO baseline performance with a moderate annotation budget ( 5 5 – 10 % 10\% ).
This amount of label information seems to be needed to obtain accurate score estimates through graph-based label spreading.
A Bayesian blending of initial Grounding DINO score and our methods estimate leads to immediate improvements and performs comparably with hard-label injection that resorts predictions according to GT. Absolute gains in AP range from 1 percentage point at 10 % 10\% to 4 4 at 100 % 100\% budget.
To further investigate annotation quality, we compute precision and recall of COCO pseudo-labels for Bayesian PLS at 1 % 1\% annotation budget. We threshold annotations at the value that maximizes the F 1 F_{1} -score on labeled images. For large objects, this yields a precision of 88 % 88\% at a recall of 81 % 81\% meaning that the majority of large objects are correctly annotated.
blocks.zh:
在附录中,我们评估了所实现的数据质量,发现我们的方法以适度的注释预算(5 5 — — 10 % — 10 — — )超过了DINO基线绩效。
似乎需要这样数量的标签信息,才能通过图标传播获得准确的分数估计.
贝叶斯人混合了最初的地基DINO分数和我们的方法估计,导致立即改进,并与硬标签注射进行对比,根据GT进行预测。 AP的绝对收益从1%(10%)到4,100%(100%)的预算不等。
为了进一步调查注解质量,我们计算出贝叶斯PLS的COCO伪标签的精确度和召回率,为1%的注解预算. 我们在标有标签的图像上, 对大型物体而言,在81%的81\%的召回时,这会产生88%的精度 88\%的精度,这意味着大多数大型物体的注释正确.

blocks.en: We obtain similar results on Cityscapes and KITTI where semi-supervised methods outperform calibrated Grounding DINO and hard-label injection regarding AS. In terms of AP, however, hard-label injection is best on both datasets despite its comparatively low AS. This indicates that propagation-based methods better approximate soft labels while relative ranking of predictions is best with injection of available GT. On Pascal VOC, calibrated Grounding DINO is a strong baseline such that our method requires a larger annotation budget of around 25 % 25\% to overtake other methods in terms of both AS and AP. Interestingly, at a budget of 100%, we even achieve a higher AP than hard-label injection meaning that we improve over the optimal ranking at the fixed IoU threshold of 0.5 0.5 by smoothing label information over the graph. We discuss these dataset-specific findings further in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 在Cityscapes和KITTI上,我们取得了类似的结果,其中半监督方法的校准度超过地面DINO和关于AS的硬标签注射。 然而,就AP而言,硬标签注射在两个数据集中都是最好的,尽管其AS相对较低. 这表明,基于传播的方法更接近于软标签,而预测的相对排名最好与现有GT的注射有关。 在Pascal VOC上,校准地基DINO是一个很强的基线,因此我们的方法需要25%左右的较大的注解预算,才能在AS和AP两个方面超越其他方法. 有趣的是,在100%的预算中,我们甚至实现了一个比硬标签注射更高的AP,这意味着我们通过将标签信息比图平滑,在0.5的固定IoU阈值上提高最佳排名. 我们将在附录中进一步讨论这些数据集的具体调查结果。

blocks.en: IV-C Semi-Supervised Object Detection
blocks.zh: IV-C 半监督 对象检测

blocks.en: TABLE I : Downstream detection performance (AP in %) for Faster R-CNN, YOLOv8-L, and RT-DETR trained with different annotation sets. We compare fully supervised training with Grounding DINO pseudo-labels and our pseudo-labeling approach, distinguishing two annotation budgets (1% / 10% of labeled images provided). Best (bold) and second best (underlined) values per row are highlighted.
blocks.zh: 表格 I: 下游检测性能(AP in%),用于更快的R-CNN,YOLOv8-L,以及RT-DETR用不同的注释集培训. 我们把完全监督的培训与地面DINO伪标签和我们的伪标签方法进行比较,区分两个注释预算(提供的标签图像的1%/10%)。 每行标出最佳(粗体)和第二佳(下划线)值。

blocks.en:
We compare our method to recent methods in the field of semi-supervised object detection (SSOD).
Here, label information is provided for a small fraction of images and the task is to generate pseudo-labels for the larger remainder of unlabeled images. Label quality is assessed by downstream detection performance of a Faster R-CNN model [ 50 ] with ResNet-50 [ 51 ] backbone. We rely on the implementation of Soft Teacher [ 14 ] and follow the same training and evaluation protocol, which we describe in the appendix. Results on COCO validation data, averaged over the 5 folds of annotated training data is displayed in Figure 4 , the corresponding standard deviations are listed in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们比较我们的方法与半监督物体探测领域(裁军特别联大)的最新方法。
在此,为一小部分图像提供标签信息,任务是为更多未加标签的图像生成伪标签。 标签质量通过使用ResNet-50[51]主干线的更快R-CNN型号的下游检测性能来评估. 我们依靠执行Soft Teacher[14],并遵循我们在附录中描述的同样的培训和评估程序。 图4显示COCO验证数据的结果,平均为附加说明的5倍培训数据,附录列出了相应的标准差。

blocks.en:
We significantly outperform existing methods already with minimal training data, achieving 40.5% AP with 1% of labeled images which almost matches the performance of the model trained on the entire training data (40.9%).
This strong performance is due to the fact that, in contrast to existing learning-based methods, OVOD-based pseudo-labeling does not depend on training data since the model operates in a zero-shot setting.
The Grounding DINO baseline where annotations are used to calibrate model confidences in order to have a default choice of 0.5 0.5 for the confidence threshold of pseudo-labels performs very well already (e.g., 40.1% AP with 1% of labeled data). It is further edged out by our Bayesian PLS approach that propagates received label information over the similarity graph to estimate independent scores and blends them with Grounding DINO scores.
We optimize hyperparameter on the labeled data available as discussed in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们明显地超越了现有方法,只掌握了最低限度的培训数据,实现了40.5%的AP和1%的标注图像,几乎与整个培训数据培训模型的性能相匹配(40.9%)。
这种强效表现的原因是,与现有的基于学习的方法相比,基于OVOD的伪标签不依赖于培训数据,因为该模型是在零镜头环境下运行的.
使用说明校准模型置信度的DINO基准,以便假标签置信阈值的默认选择为0.5 0.5(例如,40.1%的AP和1%的标注数据)已经非常出色。 我们的Bayesian PLS方法进一步推波助澜,
我们在附录中讨论的标签数据上优化了超参数。

blocks.en:
We assess downstream detection performance of Faster R-CNN [ 50 ] , YOLOv8-L [ 52 ] , and RT-DETR [ 53 ] on four datasets in Table I .
We follow the official training recipes and compare AP on validation data when training on the full set of annotations vs. constructed pseudo-labels.
In addition to COCO, we also achieve comparable detection performance on Pascal VOC when training on pseudo-labels. In contrast, manual labels are superior for the driving scene datasets Cityscapes and KITTI where the gap in performance is most severe on KITTI. Our approach consistently performs better than the Grounding DINO baseline and overall, leads to competitive performance across models and datasets with limitations on complex street scene datasets, in particular, KITTI.
blocks.zh:
我们评估在表一四个数据集上更快的R-CNN[50]、YOLOv8-L[52]和RT-DETR[53]的下游探测性能。
我们遵循官方的训练食谱,并在训练整套说明与构建的假标签时,将AP的验证数据进行比较.
除了COCO之外,我们还在Pascal VOC上实现了在伪标签培训时的类似检测性能. 相比之下,手动标签对驾驶场景数据集Cityscapes和KITTI来说是优越的,在KITTI上性能差距最大. 我们的做法一贯优于地基DINO基线和总体情况,导致各种模型和数据集之间的竞争业绩,对复杂的街道场景数据集,特别是KITTI有限制。

blocks.en:
Overall, we significantly push the state of the art in SSOD, virtually matching detection performance of the fully supervised model on COCO and Pascal VOC with very little labeled data.
These results underline the effectiveness of current open-vocabulary models and their usefulness for semi-automated annotation in object detection. Given that our method closely approaches the ’ceiling’ of the fully supervised model, it should be noted that the evaluation protocol is biased towards the original dataset. These annotations are treated as the gold standard even though manual annotations have limitations as well [ 2 ] . While it is not possible to directly compare data quality between two sets of annotations (each of them being imperfect), accurate assessment of downstream detection performance requires a third, independent set of annotations.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,我们大力推进裁军特别联大的先进水平,几乎将COCO和Pascal VOC上完全监督的模型的探测性能与很少的标注数据相匹配。
这些结果凸显了当前开放式省道模型的有效性及其在物体检测中半自动注释的实用性. 鉴于我们的方法接近充分监督的模型的 " 上限 " ,应当指出,评价协议偏向于原始数据集。 这些说明被视为金本位,尽管手工说明也有局限性。 虽然无法直接比较两套说明(每套说明不完美)的数据质量,但准确评估下游检测性能需要第三套独立的说明.

blocks.en:
With the refined annotations of [ 2 ] , we can re-evaluate the performance of models on independent annotations.
The refined annotations are more rigorous and include more object annotations than the original ones. For COCO, Pascal VOC, and Cityscapes, a similar pattern as in Table I can be observed. Pseudo-labeling leads to overall competitive performance, where full supervision remains clearly best on Cityscapes, while pseudo-labeling is best on Pascal VOC and results are mixed on COCO. Results on KITTI, however, change significantly. Models trained on pseudo-labels were evaluated as significantly worse on original annotations but actually score better on refined annotations, compared to models trained on the original data. This highlights the dependence on evaluation data, where YOLOv8-L, e.g., drops from 77.7% AP on original labels to only 21.7% when evaluating on the refined annotations.
We refer to the appendix for the full performance results on independent annotations and training details.
blocks.zh:
有了[2]的精细说明,我们可以重新评价模型在独立说明上的性能.
精细的注释更为严谨,包含的对象注释比原始的要多. 对于COCO,Pascal VOC和Cityscapes,可以观察到表一中的类似模式. Pseudo-labeling会导致总体竞争表现,在Cityscapes上,全面监督显然仍然是最佳的,而伪标签在Pascal VOC上则是最好的,在COCO上的结果好坏参半. 然而,韩国科技创新倡议的成果发生了重大变化。 与接受过原始数据培训的模型相比,接受过假标签培训的模型在原注解中被评价为明显差,但实际上在精细说明中得分更好。 这凸显了对评价数据的依赖性,其中YOLOv8-L,例如,在评价精细说明时,原标签上的AP从77.7%下降到21.7%。
关于独立说明和培训细节的全部业绩结果,请参阅附录。

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-D 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Our framework has two main design choices. For one, we chose Grounding DINO rather than a different or an ensemble of open-vocabulary models. Second, we build the similarity
graph on Grounding DINO embeddings instead of using a separate model such as CLIP [ 54 ] . These choices are supported by two ablation studies, summarized in Table II .
blocks.zh:
我们的框架有两个主要的设计选择。 我们选择了地面DINO, 而不是一个不同的或者一个组合的开放式模拟模型。 第二,我们建立相似性
CLIP[54]等单独的模型。 这些选择得到两份研究的支持,摘要见表二。

blocks.en:
First, we compare Grounding DINO alone against two OVOD ensembles (adding
YOLO-World [ 38 ] , and additionally OWL-ViT [ 37 ] ). We first calibrate models individually and retain predictions with calibrated confidence of at least 0.5 0.5 . To pool predictions, we apply NMS with an IoU threshold of 0.5 0.5 , where in case of overlap, Grounding DINO boxes are kept.
We measure pseudo-label quality in terms of recall and precision on COCO training data at an IoU threshold of 0.5 0.5 .
Recall remains essentially identical indicating that the other models do not detect any GT objects that Grounding DINO missed. However, they introduce false positives so that precision drops slightly and Grounding DINO alone achieves the highest F 1 F_{1} score.
Ensembling with additional OVODs does not prove to be beneficial as it trades away precision for no gain in recall.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们仅将地面DINO与两个OVOD组合(添加
YOLO-World [38],另外还有OWL-VIT [37]. 我们首先单独校准模型,并保留至少0.50.5的校准置信度的预测. 对于集合预测,我们采用离子体临界值为0.5 0.5的NMS,在重叠的情况下,将DINO箱放入其中。
我们从COCO培训数据的召回和精确度的角度,在0.5的IoU阈值上测量伪标签的质量。
召回的内容基本上相同,表明其他型号没有探测到地面DINO漏掉的任何GT物体。 然而,它们引入了假阳性,使得精度略微下降,而仅地面DINO就取得了最高的F 1 FQQQ1}分数.
加上额外的OVOD并没有什么好处,因为它以精度交易而无益于召回。

blocks.en:
Second, we compare performance for two similarity graphs. One from Grounding DINO’s own
decoder embeddings and one built from CLIP embeddings of the
same detections. The CLIP graph leads to poorer performance where particularly for small budgets, label information is not sufficiently captured.
We therefore build the graph on Grounding DINO’s embeddings directly. It is the simpler design and consistently performs best on both metrics.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们比较两个相似性图表的性能。 一个来自DINO自己的
解码器嵌入器和由 CLIP 嵌入器制成
同样的检测。 CLIP图导致业绩较差,特别是对于小预算,标签信息没有得到充分收集。
因此,我们直接在DINO的嵌入物上绘制图表。 这是较简单的设计,在两个衡量标准上一贯表现最好。

blocks.en: IV-E Active Querying of Objects to Annotate
blocks.zh: IV-E 主动查询要注释的物体

blocks.en: Fig. 5 : Active querying results: We compare performance in terms of AS (left) and AP (right) on COCO for four querying strategies that choose different nodes to annotate next.
blocks.zh: 图5:主动查询结果: 我们比较COCO上的AS(左)和AP(右)的性能,用于选择不同的节点来进行下一个注释的四个查询策略.

blocks.en:
From a practical perspective, we aim to further reduce annotation effort by actively querying labels.
On COCO validation data, we query one label at a time and evaluate achieved AS and AP after every 100 queries. With each queried label, the soft label predictions are updated and we can assess aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in every graph node.
We compare three strategies to the baseline of random querying.
Querying by aleatoric uncertainty which is quantified as the Shannon entropy of current soft label estimates to focus on ambiguous instances.
Querying by epistemic uncertainty, quantified by the number of virtual labels received in each node to annotate the node that received the least label information so far.
And, an equally weighted mixture of the two sources of uncertainty, where we normalize quantities using the maximal and minimal value occurring.
Overall, the results in Figure 5 show that active querying by uncertainty can further reduce the annotation effort required to achieve a certain degree of data quality.
Querying by epistemic uncertainty ensures broad coverage of the feature space, improving both metrics over the random baseline. Meanwhile, querying by aleatoric uncertainty may overly focus on boundary regions where ambiguous instances reside, reducing the quality of soft labels through noisy labels. However, the mixture of both sources of uncertainty shows best performance in terms of AP. While AS and AP behave quite differently, it can be concluded that both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty are relevant for active querying.
blocks.zh:
从实际角度看,我们的目标是通过积极查询标签,进一步减少注解努力。
在COCO验证数据上,我们一次查询一个标签,每100次查询后评价实现的AS和AP. 每个被询问的标签,软标签预测都会更新,我们可以评估每个图表节点的厌食和感知不确定性.
我们比较了三种策略与随机查询的基线.
以疲劳的不确定性进行查询,这种不确定性被量化为当前软标签估计的香农 en,以侧重于模棱两可的例子。
通过感知不确定性进行查询,量化每个节点收到的虚拟标签数量,以对迄今为止收到的标签信息最少的节点进行注释.
而且,两种不确定因素的加权混合, 我们用最大和最小的值使数量正常化。
总体而言,图5的结果表明,通过不确定性进行主动查询可进一步减少为实现一定程度的数据质量所需的注释工作。
通过感知不确定性进行查询,确保了对特征空间的广泛覆盖,使两个度量标准都比随机基线有所改善。 同时,由于情绪不稳而引发的质疑可能过于侧重于存在模棱两可情况的边境地区,通过吵闹的标签降低了软标签的质量。 然而,两种不确定因素的混合表明在行动方案方面表现最好。 虽然AS和AP的行为相当不同,但可以得出结论,厌食和癫痫不确定性都与主动查询相关.

blocks.en: IV-F Label Error Detection via Label Smoothing
blocks.zh: 通过标签平滑检测标签错误

blocks.en:
Using the label error evaluation protocol of [ 2 ] , we assess the effectiveness of our framework for detecting label errors such as missing or poorly localized annotations.
Our method smoothens all GT labels over the graph of detected objects such that false positive predictions that are semantically similar to true positives are considered as plausible label error proposals.
The pool of label error proposals are NMS-filtered Grounding DINO predictions (IoU ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 ) with confidence of at least 0.01. We compare ranking quality of these proposals between a random sorting baseline, Grounding DINO and Bayesian PLS. Hyperparameters of Bayesian PLS are optimized towards AP on held-out data using only original annotations.
Results in terms of AP and highest F 1 F_{1} -score are listed in Table III . Bayesian PLS is best on COCO and Cityscapes while Grounding DINO alone is best on KITTI and Pascal VOC. Notably, our approach is best on Cityscapes where relatively few label errors exist and worst on KITTI, where original and refined annotations are quite different. Since label propagation increases bias towards GT, it can improve label error detection when annotations are mostly complete but inherits a bias when original and refined annotations diverge.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed a framework for graph-based semi-supervised learning in object detection. It enables the semi-automated annotation of object detection datasets with uncertainty-aware soft labels.
We demonstrated its effectiveness by comparing it to baselines in terms of achieved soft label quality on multiple soft-labeled datasets.
We showed that semi-automatically constructed COCO annotations are of high quality as training on them leads to virtually matching downstream detection performance, compared to training on manually constructed data. This sets a significantly improved new state of the art for semi-supervised object detection in the regime of partially labeled COCO training data.
We further demonstrated that data-centric evaluation heavily depends on the evaluation data and treating manual annotations as the gold standard is an implicit assumption that may limit the accurate assessment of pseudo-label quality.
We integrated active querying techniques and demonstrated their potential to further reduce annotation effort required to achieve high data quality.
Finally, we showed that our framework is able to effectively uncover label errors in existing datasets by smoothing labels over the object-level similarity graph, achieving state-of-the-art performance on two out of four datasets.
To support reproducibility and further research, we make our source code publicly available under https://github.com/JonathanKlees/lpod .
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个基于图表的半监督的物体探测学习框架。 它能够半自动地对带有不确定性意识软标签的物体检测数据集进行注释.
我们通过在多个软标签数据集上实现软标签质量方面将其与基线相比较,证明了其有效性。
我们显示,半自动构造COCO说明的质量很高,因为有关这些说明的培训使得下游的探测性能几乎与人工构造数据的培训相匹配。 这为部分标注COCO训练数据制度下的半监督物体探测设定了显著改进的新工艺水平.
我们还表明,以数据为中心的评价严重依赖评价数据,并将手工说明视为金本位是一种隐含的假设,可能限制对伪标签质量的准确评估。
我们综合了主动查询技术,并展示了它们进一步减少实现高数据质量所需的注释工作的潜力。
最后,我们表明,我们的框架能够有效地发现现有数据集中的标签错误,方法是在对象级别相似度图上平滑标签,实现四个数据集中两个数据集的最新性能。
